jp:
スペシャルウィークは
どこか元気がない様子だ。

はぁ……このところ、
ぐっすり寝ても疲れが取れないんです。

夢にまで見たトゥインクル・シリーズに
たくさん出られてるのに……。

あ――で、でも心配しないでください！
きっと、その、すぐ元気になりますから！

今後の活躍のためにも、
レースの予定を見直す必要がありそうだ……。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week appears to be feeling down.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sigh... I never feel rested lately, no matter how much I sleep.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Even though I've been able to run in so many of the Twinkle Series races that I always dreamed of...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oh, but please don't worry! I'm sure I'll snap out of this funk in no time!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: It looks like I need to rethink her race schedule to keep her from burning out...

jp:
スペシャルウィークと食事中なのだが、
どこか元気のない様子だ。

すみません……なんだか最近、
ため息ばかりで……はぁ……。

レースは大好きですけど、
ワクワクしないというか……。

ごはんも美味しく感じないし……
私、どうしちゃったんでしょう。

今後の活躍のためにも、
レースの予定を見直す必要がありそうだ……。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Sitting down to eat with Special Week, I notice that she isn't her usual cheerful self.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sigh...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sorry... I seem to be sighing a lot lately, for some reason... Sigh.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I love racing, but it doesn't make me feel excited...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: And food doesn't taste good to me either. I don't know what's going on with me.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: It looks like I need to rethink her race schedule to keep her from burning out...

jp:
大ぶりの雨が降った翌日の
トレーニングコースにて――

うう……。
トレーナーさん……。

ここに来るまでの道で、
水たまりに派手に転んじゃったんです……。

うう～！　せっかく雨に負けないように、
気合い入れて来たのに～！

せっかくのやる気が、
思わぬ不運で削がれてしまったようだ……。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: At the training track after a day of heavy rain...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Urgh... Trainer...
choices: What's wrong?!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I tripped and fell straight into a puddle on my way here...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ugh! And I'd even hyped myself up to make sure I wouldn't let the rain get me!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Thanks to that, I think I've lost all my motivation...

jp: スペシャルウィーク、入ります～……。

何やら元気がないので、よく観察してみると、
スペシャルウィークの目元にくまがあった。

実は、鎧を着た巨大なにんじんの集団に、
『大根も食べろ～』って怒られる
夢を見て……。

そのせいで眠れなくて……。
私、大根も大好きなのになんででしょう……。

スペシャルウィークはしばらくの間、
この謎の夢に悩まされたようだった……。

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Special Week, clocking in...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week looks wilted as she comes in, and closer inspection reveals bags under her eyes.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I had a dream where these angry, giant carrots in armor kept yelling that I have to eat daikon radishes...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm so tired... I don't even know why I had that nightmare. I love daikon radishes...
choices: Y-yeah, who knows...
Y-yeah, who knows...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: The strange dream seems to torment Special Week for quite a while...

jp:
さっき、自販機で『ミステリードリンク』
っていう中身がわからない飲み物を
見つけちゃって……。

面白そうって気になって飲んでみたんですが、
その後から体の調子が、変なんです……！

熱いような、寒いような、痛いような、
苦しいような、よくわからないんです～！

スペシャルウィークはその後もしばらく、
どこか調子が悪そうな状態だった……。

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Urk... My body...
choices: Is something wrong?
Is something wrong?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I found a vending machine earlier that sells mystery drinks...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: It was so intriguing, I just had to try one. But now my body's been feeling weird ever since!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I don't even know how to describe how I feel! I'm kind of hot, but also cold? And it sort of hurts too.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week continues to feel generally unwell for a while...

jp:
ある朝、スペシャルウィークが
登校しているのを見かけたのだが――

んん……もっと、
位置取りを考えて……むにゃむにゃ。

――はっ！！　あれ……？
レースは……夢かぁ。

はぁ、レースのことで頭がいっぱい……。
また夜更かししちゃったよ～……ふわぁ。

スペシャルウィークはあまり
睡眠が取れていないのかもしれない。
こちらも気にかける必要がありそうだ。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: One morning, I catch sight of Special Week as she's on her way to class.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Mmm... I need to think more about positioning... Yaaawn.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh?! The race... It was all a dream...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sigh. I've been thinking nonstop about the race... And it kept me up late again... Yaaawn.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: It looks like Special Week is having trouble sleeping. I need to take that into consideration.

jp:
昼休みに、カフェテリアへ行くと
大盛りのサラダを食べている
スペシャルウィークを見かけた――

ふぅ……ニキビには野菜がいいって、
テレビで言ってたし……。

首の後ろとはいえ、人に見られたら、
きっと笑われちゃう。
レースまでにはしっかり治さないと……！

はぁ……。
だけど、それまで野菜ばっかりかぁ……。

肌荒れに関するスペシャルウィークの悩みは、
なかなか尽きなそうだった。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: I head to the cafeteria for lunch and find Special Week eating a massive helping of salad.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Phew... They said on TV that eating veggies help with getting rid of pimples.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: It's just on the back of my neck, but I'm worried that people will laugh if they see it.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I've gotta get rid of it before the race!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sigh... But that means I'll have to eat veggies until then...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: It looks like Special Week's qualms about her skincare regimen won't go away so easily.

jp:
……えへへ、やっぱりレースは緊張しますね。
朝から心臓がバクバクしてます。

でも、勝てば日本一のウマ娘に近づける。
そう思うと、ちょっと楽しみでもあるんです。
全力を出し切ってこい！
全力を出し切りましょう！
はいっ！　行ってきますっ！！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huff... huff...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe, I guess races are always gonna make me feel nervous. My heart's been pounding since this morning.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: But if I win, the thought of being one step closer to becoming the top Umamusume in all of Japan gets me a little excited.
choices: Give it all you've got out there!
Give it all you've got out there!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I sure will! Here I go!

jp:
トレーナーさん！
今日の私の走り、よく見ててください！

前回は不甲斐ない走りをしちゃいましたが……
今度こそ、みんなをあっと言わせてみせます！

はい！
今日までのがんばり、全部出し切ってきます！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Trainer! Please watch my race closely today!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: My running last time was a bit disappointing, but I'll make sure everyone's jaw drops this time!
choices: I can't wait!
I can't wait!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Okay! I'm gonna put all the hard work we've done on full display today!

jp:
これから、トゥインクル・シリーズを
担当ウマ娘と駆け抜ける日々が始まる。
ともに歩む彼女の名前は――
スペシャルウィークですっ！

あの、私、お母ちゃんが誇りに思えるような
日本一のウマ娘になりたいんです！

これから全力でけっぱりますので、
どうぞよろしくお願いします！

こうして、<chrname>との
トゥインクル・シリーズへの挑戦が
始まったのだった！

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm Special Week!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: And, um, I wanna make my moms proud by becoming the top Umamusume in all of Japan!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm gonna try my very best from here on out, so I'll be counting on you!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!

jp:
……はい、はい。了解です！
では各ステージにも中継をつないでください。

トレーナーさん。
各所滞りなく大盛況とのことです。
今から第2部のスタート……そして。

『GIRLS' LEGEND U』のお披露目と
なります。

はい。この曲はここAステージだけでなく、
Bステージ、Cステージ……他ステージでも
同時に披露されます。

全ウマ娘が同時に歌い、
ファンと同時に盛り上がる予定です。
随分と大仕掛けですね

ふふっ、技術さんたちに力を総結集
してもらいましたから。必ず楽しませますよ。

ウマ娘さんも、ファンの方も。
――そしてあなたもっ！

トレーナーさん！　外、なまらすごいです！
たくさんの人が会場中にいーっぱいで……。
これがみんなで作ったライブなんですね……！

私、メンバーの方にもファンの方にも、
誰にも負けないくらい大きな声を出しますっ！
最後方の人までちゃんと届くくらい！

春も夏も秋も冬も超え、
願い焦がれ……。

ふふっ、面白いわよね、この歌。
だって最終的に走りに繋がるんだもの。

でもそれが私たちウマ娘らしいよね。
本当に素敵な歌詞になったと思う！

いくぞーっ、みんなー！
全力で歌も想いも届けるよーっ！

このライブで君たちは力を得るだろう！
己の可能性を広げ、関係の有用性を高め、
限界をも乗り超えたまえ！
ふふっ、それはタキオンもね。

まだ終われない、終わらない！
みんなで歌おう！
『GIRLS' LEGEND U』を！

後はステージに『GIRLS' LEGEND U』
が流れるだけだ――

en.name: Light Hello
en.text: Yes... yes, understood! Please connect the live feeds from all of the stages.

en.name: Light Hello
en.text: Trainer, it's a resounding success across the entire venue. Part two is just about to start, and with it...

en.name: Light Hello
en.text: It's time for "Girls' Legend U."
choices: ...The moment we've all been waiting for, huh.

en.name: Light Hello
en.text: Yes, the performance will take place not only here at stage A, but also at stages B and C... all stages at the same time.

en.name: Light Hello
en.text: Every performer across the event will be singing at the same time, and every fan will be cheering along.
choices: Sounds like quite the spectacle.

en.name: Light Hello
en.text: Hehe. The technicians put a lot of hard work into this, so I'm certain it'll be a fun time.

en.name: Light Hello
en.text: For the girls, the fans... and you!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Trainer! Have you seen what it's like out there?! The whole venue is packed full of people...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I guess that's what happens when we all put on one big show together!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm gonna sing louder than anyone else on stage—or in the crowd! Even the folks in the very back'll hear me loud and clear!

en.name: Silence Suzuka
en.text: Whether it's springtime or summer or autumn or winter, burn with hope and ambition...

en.name: Mihono Bourbon
en.text: ...And run.

en.name: Silence Suzuka
en.text: Heh, this song's funny, isn't it? In the end, it somehow comes back to running.

en.name: Smart Falcon
en.text: What else would you expect from a song about us? I think the lyrics turned out great!

en.name: Smart Falcon
en.text: All right! Deep breaths...

en.name: Smart Falcon
en.text: Here we go, everyone! Let's make sure our song and emotions are heard!

en.name: Mihono Bourbon
en.text: Woo.

en.name: Agnes Tachyon
en.text: You will gain power from this performance, I'm sure of it! Now go expand your potential, strengthen the utility of your bonds, and overcome your limits!

en.name: Silence Suzuka
en.text: Hehe. That goes for you too, you know.

en.name: Smart Falcon
en.text: We can't end it here—we're just getting started! C'mon, let's sing "Girls' Legend U" together!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Now all that's left is to let "Girls' Legend U" play.

jp:
って。と、トレーナーさん！？
い、今の見ちゃいました？

えへへ……実は友だちから借りた漫画を
一気読みしちゃって……。

でも、ほんっとうに面白かったんです！
続きも全部借りてきちゃいました！

……あ、今度は夜更かししないように
気を付けますからっ！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Yaaaaawn...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh, Trainer?! S-sorry, I'm a little tired today.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe... To be honest, I borrowed a comic from my friend and read it all in one go...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: But it was so interesting! I went and borrowed the rest of the volumes too!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: ...Oh, I promise not to stay up all night reading!

jp:
トレーナーさんっ！
おはようございます！

昨日はたっぷり休めました。
どうやら疲れがたまっていたみたいです。

布団もかけずに熟睡してたって
スズカさんに言われて……えへへ。

そんなわけで、今は元気いっぱいです！
トレーニングもばっちりこなしますからっ！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Good morning, Trainer!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I slept super well last night.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Suzuka said I went out like a light without even getting under my blanket, hehe.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: That's why I'm so full of pep now! I'm gonna crush my training today!

jp:
出かけた後、スペシャルウィークを
寮まで送り届けると――
えへへ、今日は楽しかったですね！

トレーナーさんと一緒に出かけるのって
なんだか特別な感じがします。

お母ちゃんや友だちと出かけるときよりも
ちょっとだけ緊張するので……。
あっ……もちろん悪い意味じゃないですよ！

むしろ嬉しいからこそ緊張する……みたいな！
う、うまく説明できないですけど……。
お母さんとはどこに出かけるんだ？
お母さんとはどこに出かけるの？
友だちとはどこに出かけるんだ？
友だちとはどこに出かけるの？

むしろ嬉しいからこそ緊張する……みたいな！
う、うまく説明できないですけど……。
お母さんとはどこに出かけるんだ？
お母さんとはどこに出かけるの？
友だちとはどこに出かけるんだ？
友だちとはどこに出かけるの？

お母ちゃんとは、お向かいの畑を
手伝いに行ったり……。

あとは近所のおばあちゃんに
回覧板を届けに行ったりしてました。

……って、あれ？
これって……お出かけなのかな？

ううん、特別な場所じゃなくても
楽しかったらお出かけですよね、ふふっ！

えっと～、エルちゃんに激辛グルメのお店に
連れて行ってもらったり――

キングちゃんと大盛りラーメンに
挑戦しに行ったりとか……。

――ってなんか食べてばっかり……！？
あわわ、恥ずかしい……。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: After a day out with Special Week, I walk her back to the dorm.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe, today was so much fun!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: It feels different when I hang out with you, Trainer.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: It's not like when I go out with my mom or with my friends. I actually feel a little nervous...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oh! But I don't mean that in a bad way!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I think my excitement is turning into nervousness... It's hard to explain....
choices: Where do you usually go with your mom?
Where do you usually go with your mom?
Where do you usually go with your friends?
Where do you usually go with your friends?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I think my excitement is turning into nervousness... It's hard to explain....
choices: Where do you usually go with your mom?
Where do you usually go with your mom?
Where do you usually go with your friends?
Where do you usually go with your friends?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: With my mom, we go to the farm across the road and help out...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: And we hand out community notices to the old folks around the neighborhood.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hang on a second... Does that even count as going out?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Actually, yeah it does! Going out doesn't always have to be to some special place. It's just gotta be fun, hehe!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Uhhh, El takes me to restaurants with super spicy food sometimes...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: And with King, I take on giant ramen bowl challenges...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hold up. Is eating all I do? Aww, that's kinda embarrassing...

jp:
出かけた後、
スペシャルウィークと学園に帰ってきた。

今日もありがとうございました、
トレーナーさん！

えへへ、こうして一緒にお出かけするのも
なんだか慣れてきましたね。

でもトレーナーさんと一緒に行きたいところ、
まだまだあるんですよ！　例えば……。
あっ、そうです！　遊園地とか！

トレーナーさんは絶叫系とかおばけ屋敷は
平気かなって考えてたら、行きたくなって。

ちなみに私は怖いの苦手なんですけど、
ヒヤヒヤする感じがクセになるというか……。

あっ、でもおばけ屋敷の中で
後ろから押すのは絶対ダメですからね！

おお～……山登りですか！
それは考えてませんでした！

足腰とか、精神力とか、いろいろ
鍛えられそうな感じがしますね……！

あっ、そうだ！　山で景色を見ながら
お弁当を食べるのはどうですか？

お弁当は任せてください！　こう見えて
タコさんウインナーは得意なんです、ふふっ！

en.name: Monologue
en.text: After a day out together, Special Week and I return to the academy.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thanks for today, Trainer!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe, I'm getting used to hanging out with you like this.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: But there are still so many things I want us to do together! Like...
choices: Go to an amusement park?
Go hiking?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oooh, yeah! An amusement park!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thinking about how you'd react to being on a roller coaster or in a haunted house really makes me wanna go.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm not so good with scary things, but there's something about the thrill of it all...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oh, but don't you dare sneak up on me in the haunted house!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oooh, hiking! That didn't even cross my mind!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: That'd definitely help me train both my body and soul!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oh, I know! Let's pack some lunches so we can eat while admiring the mountain scenery!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Leave lunch to me! You might not know this, but I make these great little sausages that look like octopuses! Hehe!

jp:
出かけた後、学園までの道を
スペシャルウィークと歩いていると――

ふぅ～……！
今日も楽しかったぁ……！

こっちに来たばかりの頃は、
不安なことも多かったんですけど――

トレーナーさんが傍にいてくれるおかげで
その不安がなくなってきた気がするんです。

トレーナーさんはいつも頼りになるし、
一緒にいると落ち着くし……。
改めて、すごい人なんだなあって思います。
お母さん代わりだと思ってくれていいよ
知恵と経験ってところかな

ええっ！？
そ、それはさすがに申し訳ないですよ……！！
それに、なんというか、う～ん……。

……お母ちゃんとトレーナーさんは別です。
代わりとか、そういうのじゃなくて。

だから、これからもトレーナーさんとして
傍にいてください。お願いします！
え……そうなんですか？　ちょっと意外です。
だけど……なんか親近感が湧きますね。

私も宿題忘れて先生に怒られたり、
傘を忘れてずぶ濡れになったりするので――

そうだ！　もしトレーナーさんが
失敗しちゃった時は、私がお手伝いします！

いつもお世話になってる分、
い～っぱいがんばりますよ！

知恵と経験……！！
なんかすっごく大人っぽい響き……っ！！

わ、私も身につけたいです、知恵と経験！！
どうやったら身につきますか！？

たくさん本を読むとか……？
いろんな人とお話するとか……！？

い、いろいろ……それじゃわからないです！！
もっと教えてください、トレーナーさん！！

en.name: Monologue
en.text: After a day out, Special Week and I are walking back to the academy when...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Phew! Another day full of fun!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I was so anxious about everything when I first came here, but now...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Having you by my side has made all that go away.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I can always rely on you, and it really helps me calm my nerves when we get to spend time together.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: You're really incredible, Trainer.
choices: Just think of me as your mom away from home.
I'm less put together than you think.
It comes from wisdom and experience.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Whaaat?! I-I couldn't possibly do that!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Uh, how do I put this...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: You and my mom are different. It's not about you taking her place.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: So please continue to be there for me in your own unique way, Trainer. Please!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh, really? That's a little unexpected.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: But... I can relate to that.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I get scolded by my teachers for forgetting my homework or leaving my umbrella behind when it's raining—silly things like that...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I know! If you ever mess something up, I'll be there to help you!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'll do my absolute best because you've always had my back!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Wisdom and experience! That sounds so mature!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I wanna gain wisdom and experience too! How can I go about doing that?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Should I read a bunch of books? How about talking to a lot of different people?!
choices: That, and a lot of other things too.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: M-more things? That's so vague! Give me more to work with, Trainer!

jp:
外出後、スペシャルウィークを寮の前まで
送り届けたのだが……。

今日はありがとうございました。
お出かけ、すっごく楽しかったです！

……けど、トレーナーさん。
私、今日はこのまま帰りたくないです。

リフレッシュした分、今ならすご～く
トレーニングに集中できる気がします！

なので、これから付き合ってもらう
というのはどうでしょう……？
わぁ！　ありがとうございます！

ではでは、なにをしましょうか。
なんでもこなしますから、遠慮なくどーぞ！
コーナリングのコツを掴もう

なるほど、集中力のあるときに
しっかりやっておきたいトレーニングですね！

よーし！
けっぱるべぇ～！

外出のおかげで普段以上に身が入り、
スペシャルウィークは末脚のコツを
掴んだのだった！

なるほど、思った以上に難しいですもんね。
集中力のあるうちにやるのがいいのかも！

よーし！
けっぱるべぇ～！

外出のおかげで普段以上に身が入り、
スペシャルウィークはコーナリングのコツを
掴んだのだった！

en.name: Monologue
en.text: After a day out together, I accompany Special Week back to her dorm.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thank you so much for today. I had lots of fun hanging out!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: But Trainer, I don't wanna go home just yet.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Now that I'm so relaxed, I feel like I can really focus on my training.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: So could I ask you to tag along with me for a little while longer?
choices: Sure!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Yay! Thank you!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Okay, what should we do now? I'm ready for whatever, so let me have it!
choices: Let's work on your finishing dashes.
Let's work on your cornering.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I see! That's the kind of training to do when I'm really focused!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: All righty! I'm gonna crush this!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: The day out has given Special Week more motivation than usual to focus on her training, and she masters her finishing dashes!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I see. This is gonna be more difficult than I thought, so it's probably best to take it on while I've got the energy for it!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: All righty! I'm gonna crush this!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: The day out has given Special Week more motivation than usual to focus on her training, and she masters cornering!

jp:
外出から帰宅中、寄りたい場所があるという
スペシャルウィークに付いていくと……。

あ！　ここですここです！
このレンタルショップに来たかったんです。

今後の参考に、
ちょっと昔のレース映像も見たいなと思って。

えっと、今日はどっちを借りようかな？
『東京レース場総集編』もいいし、
『中山レース場総集編』も気になるし……。

うーん……。
トレーナーさんはどっちがオススメですか？

わかりました！　じゃあ早速借りてきますね！
あ、スズカさんの特集DVDも一緒に……。

スペシャルウィークは、
借りた『東京レース場総集編』を見て、
なにやら気づきを得たようだった。

わかりました！　じゃあ早速借りてきますね！
あ、スズカさんの特集DVDも一緒に……。

スペシャルウィークは、
借りた『中山レース場総集編』を見て、
なにやら気づきを得たようだった。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: While we're on our way home from a day out, I tag along with Special Week as she stops by a place she wanted to check out.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oh! Here it is! I've been wanting to come by this rental shop.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I was thinking about studying some old race videos. I think they'd help me with my future races.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hmm, what should I rent today? The Tokyo Racecourse collection sounds good, but so does the Nakayama Racecourse collection...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: This is tough... Which one do you recommend, Trainer?
choices: The Tokyo Racecourse collection.
The Nakayama Racecourse collection.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Got it! I'll rent it right now! Oh, and I'll grab Suzuka's special feature DVD too...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week seems to learn something from watching the Tokyo Racecourse collection DVD she rented.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Got it! I'll rent it right now! Oh, and I'll grab Suzuka's special feature DVD too...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week seems to learn something by watching the Nakayama Racecourse collection DVD.

jp:
スペシャルウィークと、
神社にやってきたのだが……。
すごい気迫で祈ってるな
すごい気迫で祈ってるね

え、えへへ。わかっちゃいました？
実は……最近ちょっと変なんです。

怖い夢を見ちゃうとか、靴ひもがすぐに
ほどけちゃうとか、悪いことばかりで……。

だから、こうなったら
神頼みしかないって思って！

うぅ～、神様ぁ～！
次こそはいいことがありますようにぃ～！

スペシャルウィークは、
どうやら本気で悩んでいるようだ。

わあ……ありがとうございます！
1人でお願いするより効果があると思います！
スペシャルウィークとお祈りした。

ふぅ……これでよしっと。
それじゃあトレーナーさん。
……あれ、お母ちゃんからメールだ。
わっ、すごいですよトレーナーさん！

お母ちゃんが美味しいカニを送るって！
えへへ、早速ご利益があったみたいですねっ！

早速起きたご利益に、
嬉しそうにするスペシャルウィークだった。

むむむむむ……むぅ。
これで……よしっと。

トレーナーさん、お祈りも終わりましたし
帰りましょうか――
（クルッポ～ッ！　クルッポ～ッ！）

ひゃあっ！？　は、ハトが上からフンをっ！？
とっ、トレーナーさん助けてくださ～いっ！

……残念ながらご利益に
あずかることはできなかったようだ。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week and I pay a visit to a local shrine.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hrrrmmm!
choices: That's some serious praying you're doing there.
That's some serious praying you're doing there.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe, you noticed? Actually, things have been kinda... strange for me lately.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm having nightmares, my shoelaces keep coming undone—stuff like that. I've been nothing but unlucky lately...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: So I figure my only choice is to pray!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Please send me good fortune!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week appears to seriously be troubled.
choices: I'll pray with you.
I'll pray with you.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ohhh! Thank you! I'm sure this will be more effective than if I pray on my own!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: I pray with Special Week for good fortune.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Phew... That should do it! Now then, Trainer...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Bzzz, bzzz.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh? Oh, it's an email from my mom.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Whoa! I can't believe it, Trainer!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: My mom's gonna send me some delicious crab! Hehe, it looks like we've already been blessed!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: The timely blessing puts Special Week in good spirits.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hrrrmmm! Phew... Okay, that should do it.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Now that we're done praying, let's head ba—

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Coo! Coo!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh?! Gross! Did that pigeon just poop on me?! T-trainer, heeelp!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: ...Unfortunately, it seems like Special Week's luck has run out.

jp:
やりました！
勝ちましたよ、トレーナーさん！

とにかく全力で……前に前にって思ってたら、
いつの間にかゴール板を駆け抜けてて。

――えへへ、本当に私、
レースで1着になれたんですねっ。

えへへ、勝てただけでも嬉しいのに、
褒められるともっと嬉しくなっちゃいますね！

今日のこと、お母ちゃんの手紙にも書こっと。
……ふふっ。
は、はいっ！　そうですよね！

今日は勝てたけど、次のレースはどうなるか
わからないし、気を引き締めていかないと！

ご指摘ありがとうございます！
これからも私、がんばりますね！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I did it! I won, Trainer!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I was so focused on running as fast as I can that I crossed the finish line before I even knew it.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe! I guess I am capable of coming in first!
choices: You did so well!
You were great!
Don't get complacent, now.
Don't get complacent, now.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: You got it!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe. Winning has already made my day, but getting praised is icing on the cake!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I gotta tell my mom about today in the next letter I write her. Hehe!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: O-of course! You're absolutely right!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I might've won today, but who knows what the next race will be like. I gotta stay focused!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thanks for the advice! I'm gonna keep giving it my all!

jp: ふわぁ……みんな速かったなぁ……。

でも、私も入着できたし
ちゃんと最後まで勝負することができた。

これって実力がついてきたってことですよね！
トレーナーさん！
毎日頑張っている証拠だ！
毎日頑張っている証拠だね！
もっと頑張らないとな
もっと頑張らないとね

えへへっ……。
トレーナーさんの教えがあってこそです。

でも、まだまだ上には上があります。
このまま負けていられません！

……なんだか力がみなぎってきました！
これからもけっぱるぞー！　おー！

うぐっ……やっぱり、
トレーナーさんもそう思いますか。

私が目指しているのは日本一のウマ娘……
ここで満足しちゃダメですよね。

よーし、明日からも気合い入れて
がんばるぞー！　おー！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Gahhh...Everyone's so fast...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: But I did place, so I managed to run a good race.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: That means my skills are improving! Right, Trainer?
choices:
It's proof that your efforts each day are paying
off!

It's proof that your efforts each day are paying
off!
You've gotta try harder.
You've gotta try harder.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe... Only because you've been guiding me.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: But I've still got room for improvement. I can't be resting on my laurels!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm brimming with energy right now! I'll keep up the hard work!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ah... I guess you feel the same way too.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I've got my eyes on being the top Umamusume in all of Japan... I can't be satisfied with what I've already achieved.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: All righty! I'll give it everything I've got from here on out! Wooo!

jp:
みんなの気迫が凄くって……
どんどん置いて行かれるのがわかって――

うぅっ、すごく悔しいです……！
気迫で負けた自分が情けない……っ！
トレーナーさん……ありがとうございます。

……確かに、がんばったのは事実ですもんね。
だったらそんな自分を認めてあげないと。

よしっ……今日のがんばりを忘れず、
明日からも全力でがんばっていきます！

今回のことはすっごく悔しいですけど……
だからこそ忘れちゃいけないって思うんです。

どうして負けたのか、なにが悪かったのか、
ちゃんと反省して、分析して――

しっかり次のレースに繋げたいと思います！
だから協力お願いします、トレーナーさんっ！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I... lost...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Everyone was so amazing out there... I just knew there was no way I could catch up.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Why couldn't I match their determination? I'm so ashamed of myself... Argh!
choices: But you were still great out there.
Use this loss as a springboard to future success.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thank you, Trainer...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: You're right. I can't deny that I tried my best. I should at least acknowledge that.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: All righty... I can't forget how hard I've worked today. I'm gonna use that as inspiration to give it all I've got from tomorrow onwards!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Okay... I'll do just that.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Today's loss really hurts... And that's exactly why I can't let myself forget it.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I really need to dive deep, analyzing why I lost and seeing what I did wrong.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Then I can use the knowledge I gain to do better in my next race! I hope you'll help me out, Trainer!

jp: すみません、また負けちゃいました……。

みんな速くて……追いつこうとしたのに
全然追いつけなくて……。

あんなにトレーナーさんと、
トレーニングしたのに……ぐすっ。
無理するな、また頑張ればいい
無理しないで、また頑張ろう
泣くな、日本一のウマ娘になるんだろ！
泣かない、日本一のウマ娘になるんでしょ！
う、うっ……うわぁあああああん。

ぐすっ……私、がんばります！
たくさんがんばって……次こそ必ず勝ちます！

一緒にがんばってくれる人が
こんなに近くにいるんですからっ！

……そうですよね、泣いてばかりじゃ、
日本一のウマ娘にはなれないですよね。

ぐすっ、トレーナーさん。
私をもっともっと鍛えてください。

それで、私が日本一のウマ娘になるまで
見届けてくださいっ！！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm sorry. I lost again...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Everyone is just so fast... I tried to catch up to them but it was impossible.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Even with all of the training we've been doing... Sniffle...
choices: Don't be so hard on yourself. We can try again.
Don't be so hard on yourself. We can try again.

Don't cry! You're gonna be the top Umamusume
in all of Japan, right?

Don't cry! You're gonna be the top Umamusume
in all of Japan, right?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sob... Waaahhh!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sniffle... I'll do my best! I'll work super hard and... and... definitely win next time!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Especially since you're always right by my side doing the same!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: You're right. I'll never be the top Umamusume in all of Japan if all I do is just sit here and cry.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sniffle... Trainer, please keep teaching me.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: And watch over me until I become the top Umamusume in all of Japan!

jp:
スペシャルウィークがトレーニングに来ず、
ようやく連絡が付いたのは夕方だった――

トレーニング、
行けなくってごめんなさい～……！

実は今日、スズカさんのレースがあって……
どうしても観に行きたくて、つい……！！
まあ、観戦も勉強になるし

トレーナーさん……！
うぅ、ありがとうございます。
スズカの走りは参考になったか？
スズカの走りは参考になった？

とっっっても！　やっぱりあの大逃げは、
誰にも真似できないなぁって――

『誰にも真似できない』なら
参考にはならないのでは……？
と思いつつも、話は聞いてあげたのだった。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week misses her training. It's nighttime when I finally get ahold of her.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm so sorry I couldn't make it to training!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Actually, Suzuka had a race today, and I really wanted to watch her run, so...
choices:
Well, I suppose watching a race also helps you
learn.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Trainer! Thank you for understanding.
choices: Did you learn anything from Suzuka's race?
Did you learn anything from Suzuka's race?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I realized her Runaway method is something that no one else can imitate.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: I can't help but wonder whether she really learned anything if the method can't be imitated.

jp:
はぁ……まさかトレーニング中に
ケガをしちゃうなんて……。

あ……いえ、ちょっと痛いだけなので！
このくらい、すぐに治りますよ！
いえ、本当にこれくらい――

うぅ……トレーナーさんの言う通り、
無理はしない方がよさそうですね。

手当をした後、大事を取って
その日は休養させることにした。

日本一のウマ娘になるために、って
気負いすぎてたのかなあ……。
うぅ……なんだか情けないです。

手当てをした後、大事を取って
その日は休養させることにした。
……この程度でめげる私じゃないですもん。

お母ちゃんが言ってたんです。
『ケガは子どもの勲章』だって。

――だからこのケガも、いつか日本一に
なるためにがんばった勲章になるはずです！

よしっ……とにかく治して
トレーニングを再開できるようにしますね！

手当をした後、スペシャルウィークの希望で
トレーニングを再開することにした。

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Owww...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sigh... I can't believe I got hurt during training...
choices: Let's call it a day.
We'll be more careful next time.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oh, don't worry! It only hurts a little! I'll be fit as a fiddle in no time!
choices: Overdoing it isn't going to help.
Overdoing it isn't going to help.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: No, really. This is nothi—

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ow!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ngh... You're right. I should take it easy.
After I tend to her, we agree to take the rest of the day off, just to be safe.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Okay, time to rest...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Maybe I was a little too eager to become the top Umamusume in all of Japan...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ngh... I'm so ashamed.
After I tend to her, we agree to take the rest of the day off, just to be safe.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: ...I'm not going to be discouraged by something like this.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: My mom always said that an injury is a child's badge of honor.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: So I'm sure that this injury will become a badge that shows how hard I worked to become the best in Japan!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: All righty, I'll focus on recovery so I can start training again!
After tending to Special Week's injury, I follow her wishes, and we continue our training.

jp:
トレーニング中、スペシャルウィークが
ケガをしたので急いで保健室に連れていった。

すみません、トレーナーさん……
やっちゃったみたいです……。

強くなりたいって必死だったのか、
周りが見えてなかったみたいで――
私の不注意です、ごめんなさい……。
今は治すことだけ考えよう！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいい！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいいよ！
私の不注意です、ごめんなさい……。
今は治すことだけ考えよう！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいい！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいいよ！

トレーナーさん……
ありがとうございます。

確かに、こういう時は焦らないのが大事
だってお母ちゃんも言ってました。

きちんと治して……万全な状態で
トレーニングに、もどって……。

……ぐすっ……えへへ。
私、がんばらないと……なのになぁ……。

……またトレーニングが再開できるように、
この日はしっかりとスペシャルウィークを
休ませることにしたのだった。

そ、そうですね！
すぐに治せば、遅れなんて取り戻せますし！

よし、今日のところは休養に専念しますね！
トレーナーさん、また明日！

翌日、スペシャルウィークの歩様に
ぎこちなさがあったため、もう1日休ませた。

元気づけるつもりでかけた言葉が、
逆に彼女を焦らせてしまったかもしれない。

日本一のウマ娘になるため、
この程度の壁なんて、気合いで――！

うおぉ～……！　早く治れぇ～……！
私の体ならできるはず～っ！！

……その効果があったのか、
翌日、スペシャルウィークは元気になり、
トレーニングもすぐに再開できたのだった。

en.text: Special Week injures herself during training, so I rush her to the infirmary.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sorry, Trainer... It looks like I messed up...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I guess I was so desperate to get stronger that I lost sight of what was around me.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm sorry for being so careless...
choices: Just focus on your recovery!

You should stay in bed today. We can get back
to training later!

You should stay in bed today. We can get back
to training later!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'm sorry for being so careless...
choices: Just focus on your recovery!

You should stay in bed today. We can get back
to training later!

You should stay in bed today. We can get back
to training later!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thank you, Trainer...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: You're right. Even my mom would say that it's better not to rush at a time like this.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'll make sure I get better... so I can return to training in tip-top shape.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sniffle... Heh... I've got so much work to do, and yet...
I make sure Special Week gets some proper rest today so that she can resume her training.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Y-you're right! If I get better quickly, then it won't be so hard to make up for the lost time!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Okay, I'll focus on my recovery today! See you tomorrow, Trainer!
I notice that Special Week is still limping the next day and order her to rest another day.
Perhaps my attempt to cheer her up caused her to rush her recovery when her body wasn't ready for it.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: This is just a tiny obstacle that stands in the way of me becoming the top Umamusume in all of Japan! I'll break right through it!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Rahhh! Hurry up and get better! I know you can do it, body!
Her self-motivation seems to work, as she's fully recovered and ready to train the very next day.

jp:
トレーニング後、スペシャルウィークが
なにか焦った様子で声をかけてきた。

最近、クラスの子たちが
メキメキと実力を付けてるんです。

私も負けてられません……！
今日はもう少しトレーニングしたいです！
わかった！気が済むまで走り込もう！
落ち着いて、オーバーワークになっちゃうよ

ありがとうございます！
結果が出せるように、がんばります！

その後、スペシャルウィークと
時間ギリギリまでトレーニングに打ち込んだ。

そ、そうでした……
少し熱くなりすぎてたかも。

頭、冷やさないとですね、
深呼吸、深呼吸……す～っ……は～っ……。

スペシャルウィークは落ち着いたようだ。
しかし彼女の熱意には応えていかねば……。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: After her training, Special Week, looking flustered, approaches me about something.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: The others in my class have been getting better and better lately.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I can't lose to them! So I wanna train a little more today!
choices:
Got it! Then let's do some more laps until you're
satisfied!
Don't get too excited, or you might overdo it.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thanks! I'm gonna do my best to produce some good results!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: We continue our training until the very last minute.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Y-you were right... I think I got a little too worked up.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I need to cool myself down. Deep breaths... Phew... Fwaaah

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week appears to have calmed down, but I still have to do something about her overzealousness...

jp:
トレーニングの時間、スペシャルウィークが
真剣な表情で話しかけてきた。

あ、あの……トレーナーさん……
その……すごく言いにくいんですけど……。

実は最近、体重が増えてしまいまして……
お恥ずかしい……。
なら追加トレーニングするか……！
なら追加トレーニングしよう……！
わあっ！　ありがとうございます！

私、がんばって体をしぼります！
よろしくお願いします！

スペシャルウィークはしばらく走り込み、
体重を下げることに成功した。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week approaches me during training with a serious look on her face.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Um... Trainer? Uh... This is really hard for me to say, but...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I've, uh, gained some weight recently... I'm really embarrassed.
choices:
Don't be embarrassed! Why don't we do some
extra training?

Don't be embarrassed! Why don't we do some
extra training?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Yay, that sounds great! Thank you!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: I'll train hard and be back to running form in no time! We're in this together!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week focuses on her running for a while and successfully reaches her target weight.

jp:
少し調子の悪そうなスペシャルウィークを
保健室に連れて行き、休ませることにした。

ありがとうございます、トレーナーさん！
しっかり休んで疲れを取りますね！

あれ？　あそこにいるのってもしかして
……三女神様！？

あのっ、三女神様！
私、日本一のウマ娘になりたくて――

スペシャルウィークの言葉を聞き、
三女神たちは微笑んだように見えた。
その瞬間、眩い光が辺りを埋め尽くし――
はっ……！　なんだ、夢かぁ。

……あれ？
なんだか体の調子がよくなってるような……。

元気を取り戻したスペシャルウィークは、
軽い足取りで保健室をあとにした。

スペシャルウィークの声が届かなかったのか、
三女神はどこかへと立ち去ってしまった。
その瞬間、眩い光が辺りを埋め尽くし――

あ、あれっ！？　……なんだ、夢かぁ。
けど、ただの夢じゃないような……。

夢が頭から離れず、スペシャルウィークは
十分に休むことができなかった。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week appears to be a little under the weather. I take her to the infirmary so she can get some rest.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thank you, Trainer! Once I rest up here, all my exhaustion should be gone in a jiffy!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: ...Huh, where am I?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: What? Wait a second. Are you who I think you are? The Three Goddesses?!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Um, hello to you, divine Three Goddesses! I wish to become the top Umamusume in all of Japan...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: The Three Goddesses appear to smile upon hearing Special Week's words.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: At that moment, a bright light floods the room.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh?! Oh, it was just a dream...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: ...Wait. I don't know why, but I think I feel better now.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Her vigor restored, Special Week leaves the infirmary with a spring in her step.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week's wish doesn't seem to reach the ears of the Three Goddesses, and they depart.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: At that moment, a bright light floods the room.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh?! Oh... It was all a dream... But it felt so real...

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Unable to forget the dream she had, Special Week fails to get proper rest.

jp: おはようございます、トレーナーさん！

昨日はお休みをいただき、
ありがとうございました。

えへへ。お母ちゃんとあんなにゆっくり
電話したの、久しぶりだったなぁ……。

よーし！　ちゃんとリフレッシュもできたし、
今日から改めてトレーニングがんばります！

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Good morning, Trainer!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Thanks for letting me take the day off yesterday.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Hehe, it's been so long since I got the chance to take my time and talk to my mom on the phone.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: All righty! Now that I'm all rested, I'll jump right back into training today as fresh as can be!

jp:
――うん、うん。
そっかぁ、もうそんな時期だっけ……！

懐かしいなぁ。なんか、久々にお母ちゃんの
トラクターさばき、見たくなっちゃったべ。
…………へっ？　トレーニングの時間？

……あっ、あぁ～！　それなら大丈夫だよ！
今日はその、えーっと……お休みだから！

（うぅぅ～っ、トレーナーさん、
ごめんなさい～……！）

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Mmhmm. Really? It's already that time again?!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Talk about fun memories! I kinda wanna see your tractor skills again. It's been so long, Mom.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Huh? Time for training?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ohhh! You don't have to worry about that! I've, uh... I've got today off!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: (Gahhh! I'm sorry, Trainer!)

jp:
ある日、<chrname>の体の調子を
見てもらうため、保健室へやって来ると――

あっ、はいはーい！　お客さ……じゃない、
生徒さんね！

ケガ？　病気？　それともメンタルケア？
ま、ぜーんぶドドンと任せちゃってよ！

え？　そりゃー保健室にいるんだから……
ちょっぴりファンタスティックな保健の先生？
的な？

あっはっは、さすがに騙されないか。
やっぱ普通に名乗る感じでいくわね。
ぉほん！　何を隠そう、このあたしこそ――

数多のウマ娘を（たぶん）導く救世主！
奇跡の腕を持つ（自称）伝説的笹針師！

その名も、『安心沢　刺々美』よっ！！
ワォ、あんし～ん☆

en.name: Monologue
en.text: One day, I bring <chrname> to the infirmary for a checkup.
Oh! A custo―I mean, a student! Hello!
Are you hurt? Sick? Stressed? Whatever it is, I treat it all!
choices: Who are you?!

en.text: Well, considering you're at the academy infirmary, I'd say that makes me your trusty school nurse! Yup, just your average school employee!
choices: ...No, you aren't?

en.text: Ahaha! Guess there's no fooling you. I suppose I should start by giving you my name.
Ahem! Allow me to introduce myself!
I am the (likely) savior of all Umamusume, the (self-proclaimed) legendary acupuncturist with the magic touch...

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Gosh! You sure seem worried! ☆

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: No matter! No matter! We've made our introductions, so lie down and let me put these needles to work!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Needles?! Wh-what're you gonna do with those?!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Hahaha! No need to be scared! All I'm going to do is slip these extraordinary needles precisely into your chakra points.

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Then voilà, presto! Something indescribable will happen!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: ...For my master.

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Don't fret! This is my first time, so technically, I've never failed a patient either!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: And it's not like I have no experience! I spent ten years under a legendary master, fetching dri—I mean, training!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: See? No worries! ☆
choices: (We need to get outta here stat!)

en.name: Monologue
en.text: There's no way we're doing this. I take <chrname> and head for the door, when...

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: W-wait! Where are you going?!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: You're Special Week, right?! The Umamusume blessed with two loving mothers, working hard to become the top Umamusume in all of Japan for their sakes!
choices: You've heard of her?

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Have I heard of her? Of course I have! I'm a big fan!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: That's precisely why I'm here! To give you my support! Let me help you!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Just give me a chance! Pleeease!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Uhhh... What do you think, Trainer?

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Please! Pretty please with a carrot on top! I'll even let you choose which chakra I activate!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: I'm sure I won't mess up!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Well... pretty sure.
choices: Pretty sure?!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: I mean, it's on the sure side! That's good, right? Anyway, don't get hung up on the details!

en.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
en.text: Let's get to the good stuff! Which chakra should I activate? Do you want a boost to your abilities? Your health? Or maybe your charm?

en.name: Monologue
en.text: I smell danger in the air, but I figure there might—and I emphasize might—be a chance of getting something special out of this treatment.

en.name: Monologue
en.text: What should we do?

Activate the winning chakra.
Activate the health chakra.
Activate the charm chakra.

en.text: Trainer!

jp:
スペシャルウィークの調子が
あまりよくなさそうだ……。

実は、ちょっと頭痛がするんですよ～……。
なんでかなぁ。

おいしいもの食べる夢見たからって、
3度寝したからかな……？

それとも、エルちゃんたちと分けっこして
アイスたくさん食べ過ぎたから……！？

ごめんなさいトレーナーさん……
心当たりがありすぎて、
どれが原因だかわかりません～……！

頭痛に悩まされてしまう
スペシャルウィークなのだった……。

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week doesn't seem to be feeling well...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Actually, my head kind of hurts... I wonder why...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Maybe it's because I woke up and went back to sleep twice after having dreams about eating tasty foods...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Or maybe it's because I shared a whole lot of ice cream with El and the others and ate too much...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Sorry, Trainer... I dunno what the cause is. There are just way too many possibilities!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Owww....

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week laments over her headache...

jp:
ある日、
スペシャルウィークと出かけた先で――

わっ！
とととトレーナーさん、見てくださいっ！！

あれです、あれ！
――クレーンゲームっ！！

スペシャルウィークが示すほうを見てみると、
ウマ娘たちをモチーフにしたぬいぐるみが
入った、クレーンゲームがあった。

うわー、うわーうわー……！　さすが都会っ、
こういうグッズもあるんですねぇ……！

いいなぁ……お母ちゃんにも贈ってあげたら、
喜ぶかなぁ……！

スペシャルウィークは、
これでもかというほど目を輝かせている……。
えっ！？　い、いいんですか……！！

en.name: Monologue
en.text: One day, while out with Special Week...

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Ooooh! Trainer, look!
choices: What is it?
What is it?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Over there! It's a claw machine!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: I look in the direction Special Week is pointing and see a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

en.name: Special Week
en.text: Oh my gosh, wow! You know you're out of the sticks when you find merchandise like this!

en.name: Special Week
en.text: How nice... I bet my mom would be happy if I sent her one!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: Special Week's eyes are sparkling brighter than diamonds...
choices: Do you want me to win you one?
Do you want me to win you one?

en.name: Special Week
en.text: What? R-really?!

en.name: Monologue
en.text: There's no way I can fail now!

jp:
わぁあああっ、こんなにたくさん……！！
トレーナーさん、すごいです！！

これだけあれば、お母ちゃんだけじゃなくて
グラスちゃんやエルちゃんたち、
お友だちみーんなにも配れそうです～！

それに――そうだっ、
トレーナー室にも飾りましょう！

きっと見るたび、今日は楽しかったな～って
